scripts.build: npm run build:markdown && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:migrate: cd reader-backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run build
scripts.prod: npm run setup && cd reader-backend && node dist/index.js
scripts.build:markdown: npm run build --workspace @reader/md-ast && npm run build --workspace @reader/md-view
scripts.test:markdown: npm run test --workspace @reader/md-ast && npm run test --workspace @reader/md-view
